subject: Request: mid-cycle payband alignment for Nikhil Sharma
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: mid-cycle payband alignment for Nikhil Sharma

Hi team,

I need an urgent mid-cycle compensation alignment for Nikhil Sharma (IC, IAM infra). He just received a solid external counteroffer and has signaled a 10% resignation risk if we don't match market. Given the reorg last quarter expanded his scope (now owns infra auth gateway + cross-team oncall), I am proposing the following exception: 

- Base increase: $180,000 -> $210,000 (market alignment to midpoint+10%)
- One-time cash retention: $15,000 (paid next payroll)
- Equity refresh: $40,000 (refresh grant to be added at next cycle)

Attached is a compact proposal with comp band data and comparable market points (comp_proposal_Nikhil_v1.xlsx). Time-sensitive: candidate indicated deadline Thursday COB.

Asking for HR/Comp review and VP approval path. Budget owner (Laura) is looped. Please confirm what approvals we need and whether we can push an interim retention payment before the full comp package is finalized.

Thanks,
Sean

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com

Attachments: comp_proposal_Nikhil_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-cycle payband alignment for Nikhil Sharma

Thanks Sean — I got the proposal and reviewed the attachment briefly. We can consider a mid-cycle exception but need the following before Comp signs off: 

1) Manager note confirming sustained performance at the new scope and examples of impact (success metrics).
2) Current total cash and on-target earnings (confirm variable comp) + current equity holdings schedule.
3) Confirmation of available headcount/budget or offset plan (where will delta come from).
4) Legal/Finance check on whether a one-time cash retention can be advanced before final approval (payroll cutoff timing).

If you can provide the manager note and updated comp snapshot today, I'll prioritize this with the comp committee and route to Vivek for exception approval. If budget owner (Laura) can confirm headcount/budget alignment, that will speed things up.

I marked this high priority and added JIRA-HR-4821 for tracking.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
People Operations (Compensation)
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-cycle payband alignment for Nikhil Sharma

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 11:03 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Sean — I got the proposal and reviewed the attachment briefly. We can consider a mid-cycle exception but need the following before Comp signs off: 
> 
> 1) Manager note confirming sustained performance at the new scope and examples of impact (success metrics).
> 2) Current total cash and on-target earnings (confirm variable comp) + current equity holdings schedule.
> 3) Confirmation of available headcount/budget or offset plan (where will delta come from).
> 4) Legal/Finance check on whether a one-time cash retention can be advanced before final approval (payroll cutoff timing).
> 
> If you can provide the manager note and updated comp snapshot today, I'll prioritize this with the comp committee and route to Vivek for exception approval. If budget owner (Laura) can confirm headcount/budget alignment, that will speed things up.

Marissa, Sean — below are the manager notes and budget confirmation. I'm attaching a short calibration note and Nikhil's performance highlights (mgr_calibration_note.pdf). Summary: 

- Nikhil exceeded goals in Q2 (reduced auth gateway P99 latency by 28%, led cross-team rollout) and has taken on two additional projects after reorg.
- No immediate headcount to backfill; I can cover delta by holding one open hire for this quarter and reassigning a small amount from contractor budget.
- Current cash: base $180,000, target OTE ~$210,000 with variable. Current RSU schedule vests next in March.

Given the retention risk and business continuity on the infra side, I recommend the proposed base uplift + $15k retention + equity refresh. If comp committee needs further detail, I can join the call.

Laura Bennett
Director, Identity & Infrastructure
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: mgr_calibration_note.pdf (manager justification, 18KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-cycle payband alignment for Nikhil Sharma

Thanks all — reviewed the manager note and Marissa's checklist. I approve a one-time mid-cycle exception with the following conditions: 

- Base increase to $205,000 (comp compromise to keep within band guardrails)
- One-time cash retention payment of $12,500 to be processed on next payroll cycle (Finance to confirm payroll cutoff)
- Equity refresh of $30,000; comp to write the grant and HR to schedule grant issuance next cycle
- Laura to absorb delta within her org budget as stated (hold open hire + contractor funds)

Marissa/Monica: please process JIRA-HR-4821, attach signed approval (signed_approval_vivek.pdf) and confirm timelines back to me and to Sean. If payroll can't process the cash before candidate deadline, authorize a short-term bridge (paid ASAP) and reconcile in December payroll.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Operations & GTM
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: signed_approval_vivek.pdf (approval, 4KB); DocuSign: https://docusign.redwood.com/sign/Nikhil_2026_approval
